benchmarkNotes.gaia: We evaluate all 165 GAIA validation tasks through Harbor and ACP, using normalized answer matching and counting execution errors as zero. The official main leaderboard uses the test split, while this board uses the public validation split. No LLM judge is used.
benchmarkNotes.spreadsheetbench-verified: We evaluate 400 SpreadsheetBench V1 Verified tasks by comparing target cells after LibreOffice recalculation, counting execution errors as zero. The official V1 Full set contains 912 tasks; this board uses its Verified subset. Scoring is programmatic and uses no LLM judge.
benchmarkNotes.swebench-verified: We evaluate all 500 SWE-bench Verified tasks by applying agent patches and running repository tests, reporting resolution rate with execution errors counted as zero. We use the SWE-bench Verified task set and test scoring through Harbor and ACP, with internet access enabled. No LLM judge is used.
benchmarkNotes.pawbench: We evaluate 150 PawBench v1.0 tasks, preserving their programmatic and model-judge weights and averaging task scores with execution errors counted as zero. This board uses qwen3.8-max for model judging, while the officially published results use Claude Opus 4.6. The judge-model difference is part of the comparison settings.
